findings.title: Concurrent-deletion NPE remains in paginated subgroup methods
findings.body: The fix null-checks only getSubGroupsCount(). The three paginated getSubGroupsStream overloads at lines 254-269 still do modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. If the cached group is deleted concurrently and the delegate lookup therefore returns null, these methods throw the same NullPointerException the PR is intended to eliminate, e.g. when listing/searching subgroups of a group being deleted.

findings.title: getSubGroupsCount now returns null instead of a count
findings.body: When the delegate no longer exists this returns null for a Long count that persistent implementations always return as a non-null query result. GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount propagates that null into GroupRepresentation.subGroupCount, so a concurrently deleted group can appear in a listing with a null count and any caller that unboxes/compares the count can NPE. Returning 0L for a deleted group would preserve the non-null contract while avoiding the original NPE.

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined, making the regression test racy and leaky
findings.body: The reader thread is started but never joined. The main thread sets deletedAll at line 155 and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty at line 157, while the reader may still be inside groups() and may record an exception only after the assertion, producing false passes. Conversely the unjoined busy-loop thread can outlive the test and keep calling managedRealm.admin() during/after test teardown, interfering with subsequent tests. The test should keep a Thread reference, set the flag, and join it (with timeout) before asserting.
